name: Radio Group
summary: A set of radios that share one name and belong to one field. The group is a fieldset, so the browser groups the circles for the form and for the screen reader.
summaryZh: 一组共用同一个名字、同属一个字段的单选框。组是一个 fieldset,所以表单和读屏都会把这些圆圈当成一组。

variants.name: Stacked
variants.note: One option per row, running down the panel. The base class on its own is this layout, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Inline
variants.note: The options run across the panel and wrap onto the next line when they run out of room.

states.name: Checked
states.note: The picked option takes the brand colour's own soft tint, and its text takes the foreground that was derived for that tint.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The label takes the derived disabled colour and the circle dims, the way every other disabled control in the library dims.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the circle, because the circle is what the user actually sees of the control.

parts.name: Legend
parts.note: The fieldset's own legend. It is the group's name, and the browser reads it before the options.

parts.name: Options
parts.note: The panel that holds the options. It carries the group's surface and the space between the options.

parts.name: Option
parts.note: One option. It is the label that wraps the real input, the circle and the text, so it is the element that can be asked whether its input is picked. The circle itself is the radio component's own.

props.name: name
props.description: The name every option in the group shares. It is the native name attribute, and it is what makes the group a group: the browser keeps exactly one of the options picked.
props.descriptionZh: 组里每个选项共用的名字。它是原生 name 属性,也正是它让这几个选项成为一组:浏览器保证组里恰好只有一个被选中。

props.name: value
props.description: The value one option submits while it is picked.
props.descriptionZh: 某个选项选中时提交的值。

props.name: checked
props.description: Picks one option. It is the native checked attribute, not a class.
props.descriptionZh: 选中某一个选项。它是原生 checked 属性,不是某个类。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes one option inert. It uses the real disabled attribute, so it leaves the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 让某一个选项不可用。它用的是原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序。

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the options run. The stacked run is the base class on its own; the inline run adds um-radio-group--inline.
props.descriptionZh: 选项往哪个方向排。纵向是只写基础类;横向再加上 um-radio-group--inline。

props.name: label
props.description: The text of the group's legend. A group with no legend still needs an accessible name of its own.
props.descriptionZh: 组标题的文字。不写标题的组也得有自己的可访问名称。

slots.name: legend
slots.description: The legend text, above the options.

slots.name: option
slots.description: One option: the real input, the radio component's circle and the text.
slots.descriptionZh: 一个选项:真正的 input、单选框组件的圆圈和文字。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the selection moves to an option. It is the browser's own event on the input — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 选中项移到某一个选项时触发。这是 input 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

a11y.notes: The group is a real <fieldset> with a real <legend>, so the screen reader announces the group's name before the options and reports how many there are. Every option is a real <input type="radio"> inside a <label>, so the browser keeps exactly one of them picked, the arrow keys move the selection inside the group and Tab moves between groups. The input is hidden visually rather than removed from the accessibility tree, so it keeps its place in the tab order and its label.
a11y.notesZh: 组是一个真正的 <fieldset>,配一个真正的 <legend>,所以读屏会先报出组的名字,再报出选项的数量。每个选项都是 <label> 里一个真正的 <input type="radio">,所以浏览器保证组里恰好只有一个被选中,方向键在组内移动选中项,Tab 在组与组之间移动。这个 input 只是视觉隐藏,没有被移出无障碍树,因此它仍在 Tab 顺序里,也仍然有标签。

examples.title: Stacked
examples.description: One option per row. The picked option takes the brand colour's soft tint, and the row knows it is picked because it holds the input.
examples.descriptionZh: 一行一个选项。选中的选项会带上品牌色的浅色底,而这一行知道自己是选中的,因为 input 就在它里面。
examples.markup: Plan

examples.title: Inline
examples.description: The options run across the panel and wrap onto the next line. Only the modifier class changes; the markup is the same.
examples.descriptionZh: 选项横向排开,放不下就换行。变的只有那个修饰类,标记是同一份。
examples.markup: Size

notes: The group owns the row and the text of an option, but not the circle: the circle and the real input are the radio component's own classes, so a picked option is drawn exactly like a lone radio. The group has no sizes of its own, because the circle's size belongs to the circle — a group cannot make the control it holds bigger without redrawing it. The selected row is found with :has(), which is the only way CSS can ask an element what its child is doing.
notesZh: 组拥有选项这一行和它的文字,但不拥有圆圈:圆圈和真正的 input 都是单选框组件自己的类,所以组里选中的选项和组外的单选框画得一模一样。组本身没有尺寸,因为圆圈的大小归圆圈管 —— 组想让它里面的控件变大,就得把控件重画一遍。选中的那一行是用 :has() 找到的,这是 CSS 唯一能问元素「你孩子现在怎么样」的办法。
